depiction.primary_object: six filled circles in two vertical columns of three

readings.meaning: six pips of a die or domino

ambiguity: Almost universally read in software UIs as an interactive drag handle rather than a subject icon; can also be read as a full six-dot Braille cell or the six face of a die without an outline.

reasoning: A 2x3 grid of six dots is standard UI chrome for a drag-to-reorder grip handle, which makes it look like part of the task list interface rather than a task's subject icon. Even when read as a six-dot Braille cell, placing it beside a to-do item in a list strongly invites users to try dragging the row rather than reading a topic.
